title: CONSTITUTIONAL LAW: GOVERNMENT POWERS AND CONSTRAINTS
description: Explores role of the U.S. Supreme Court in shaping the powers and limitations of the U.S. government. Analyzes the powers of the three main branches of our government, and cases where the powers of these branches clash with one another or with the powers of the states or rights of the individual.
recommendations: PS 201; critical thinking, reasoning, and writing skills
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
